title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
  • 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
  • Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
  • Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
  • Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
  • Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
  • A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
  • Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
  • Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
  • Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
  • Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
  • Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
  • Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
  • Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

  • Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
  • Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
  • Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
  • AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

Send in your application here: https://forms.gle/4yqiWvhiCMnC6xdx7

Hiring process: 1-minute intro video → intro call with the founder → portfolio walkthrough → offer. Applications reviewed continuously, start date by agreement.

See all available jobs here: https://optimizeegroup.com/#jobs

title: Face Deduplication Collection
description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

title: Senior Google Ads Account Manager - Remote (Work From Home)
description:
Who we are

We are a team of hard-working marketers running a Premier Google Partner ad agency.

We help businesses large and small. Most of our clients are located in the United States, and our team members are located throughout the United States and around the world.

Check out our website: stubgroup.com

What we're looking for

We need a Senior Google Ads Account Manager! This is a remote (work-from-home) position.

Senior Google Ads Account Managers should possess:

  1. Advanced knowledge of Google Ads and how to create and manage profitable campaigns for ecommerce and lead-generation businesses.

  2. Strong client communication skills.

You will work directly with high-value clients as their primary point of contact and will be responsible for managing client relationships and creating and managing Google Ads campaigns for them.

Compensation & growth opportunities

At StubGroup, we have a milestone-based compensation structure that rewards our team members with increasing compensation as they generate more value for the company.

Starting Compensation: New Senior Google Ads Account Managers begin with a competitive monthly salary range of $4,000 - $5,000.

Bonuses and Incentives: Senior Google Ads Account Managers who go above and beyond may also earn additional bonuses and incentives aligned with the exceptional value they create for StubGroup.

We believe teamwork is the foundation of success, and we’re committed to recognizing and rewarding the outstanding contributions of our team members. Together, we grow and thrive!

The ideal candidate

Google Ads Knowledge: Proficiency in Google Ads is essential. You will be directly managing and overseeing high-value Google Ads campaigns for lead generation and ecommerce websites. You must be expert at using the Google Ads interface and Google Ads Editor, and have an advanced understanding of campaign structures, bidding strategies, conversion tracking, etc.

Marketing Strategy: Your responsibility is to learn about each client's business, including their products, target audience, and more. Your goal is to guide clients toward strategies that maximize the profitability of their ad campaigns. Whether it's recommending website changes or addressing a client's fixation on low click-through rates at the expense of website traffic quality and conversion rates, it's your job to educate them on more effective metrics for evaluating campaign success.

Problem-Solving: Our company values self-sufficiency and resourcefulness. We expect team members to "figure it out" and take initiative, rather than asking questions that could have been answered independently. Of course, we're here to provide support when you genuinely cannot solve a problem on your own. The expectation is that you will consistently go above and beyond, overcoming obstacles instead of letting them hinder your progress.

Make sure you’re comfortable with:

  • Remote working. This is a remote (work-from-home) position.

  • All job offers start with a 60-day trial to make sure that we’re the right fit for each other.

  • Communicating with business owners who don't understand how Google Ads works

  • Juggling a large number of tasks at a time and properly prioritizing how to handle them.

  • Working from 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Central Time (United States business hours)

Our values

Integrity: Honesty is vital. We must be honest with ourselves, with our colleagues, and with our clients. We tell clients exactly what we are doing for them, and what we can or can't do to help them. If we make a mistake, we own it.

Responsibility: We are here to solve problems for clients. We are constantly looking for ways to provide more value to our clients. How do we help them succeed? How do we help our colleagues succeed? We don't shirk work. We look for more of it. By being proactive, we stand out from the crowd and win our clients' trust.

Care: We're not just in this for the money. We genuinely want our clients to be successful. We understand that we're making an impact, that we are helping businesses create jobs and put food on the table for their families. We value that trust and do not abuse it.

To apply

If you're interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: [Lastname.Firstname.Senior-Manager.pdf]

  • Details of your experience

  • Your answer to this question: If you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?

  • Your answer to this question: I get up in the morning because . . .

Submissions should go to: john+senior+manager+nomads@stubgroup.com

I am looking for people who can format their submissions in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in client management, you want to help make it as easy on the client as possible! I’m happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck with your job search!
location: Latin America, Europe, Canada, UK, South Africa
